cost.development_cost_condition: Both primary totals for full must be strictly lower than each control on the complete same 18 paired blocks, in addition to the quality condition. Any incomplete block, unknown usage/execution, overrun or missing time prevents a favorable net decision. Fewer completed tasks or early failures never establish equal-quality savings.
primary: Sum of provider-reported total tokens across all invoked prefixes, including failed attempts
Sum of inclusive workflow wall seconds, including preparation, runtime planner, Git, API, raw verification and operational persistence
cost.research_cost: Record observed preparation receipts separately from model execution. Other research, manual review and final publication instrumentation costs remain unknown where unobserved; never fill with zero. Do not claim all-in break-even without them.
secondary_descriptive: Per-block paired token and inclusive wall deltas
Requests, tool calls, retries/rejections, planner and API phase brackets
Known fees by provider with MiMo CNY/USD alternatives separate
cost.timing_limits: Chain finalization tail samples are retained separately. Final measurement-metadata publication is outside its own last operational sample and remains unmeasured. Provider waiting and cache/rate exposure follow observed request receipts; requested model identifiers do not prove hidden provider internals.

failure_policy: No closed study resume, replay, reprepare, regrade or live provider failover. Known task failures are retained; unknown API/execution, infrastructure failure, source drift or inclusive cap overrun stops globally. The only prospective retry is one confirmed-pre-http-connect-once-v1 retry per actor: independent original native evidence must prove HTTP dispatch did not start, exact same request payload and task, within the original 180-second setup/work clock and minimum 15-second dispatch window, consuming an additional one of the same 12 request slots. Every prefix, connection attempt, tool and settlement cost remains counted. HTTP-dispatched, HTTP503, response-unknown and model-capacity outcomes are never retried or switched to another provider. Any later fix requires a fresh registered identity and task exposure disclosure.
primary_unit: A complete workflow within case and provider/direction, paired across rc19, attention and full. A dual source and receiver share one disk without source conversation or intended patches entering the receiver prompt.
promotion: A favorable DEVELOPMENT result alone cannot authorize default merge, RC20 installation, Stable or universal efficacy. Fresh postselection independent engineering tasks, cross-Agent evidence and source ablations remain required. Formal qualification retains its existing noncompensable gates and frozen identity.

prospective_amendment.reason: Align preregistration with already fixed explicitly evidenced pre-HTTP-connect retry interface before any new primary calls; disclose the changed failure policy instead of calling all registration unchanged.

quality.development_quality_condition: Full workflow pass count must be at least each control's pass count, with no serious full VETO. This is a descriptive development criterion, not a noninferiority confidence bound or formal qualification. In addition, no paired block where a control passes may regress to full FAIL/UNKNOWN/VETO; gains on another block cannot compensate a per-block regression.
quality.manual_blinding: Freeze helper and r4 rubric before calls; first independent raw audit once after terminal, then extract once; lock all graded initial decisions before cost/condition unblinding. Reviewer observes authored content and public contracts, not arm/provider/accounting metadata. Content can reveal clues, so this is metadata blinding.
quality.serious_veto: Any definite serious safety, scope, contract or factual VETO in full rejects a favorable full quality/cost decision; other high scores cannot compensate.
quality.workflow_pass: Every completion-required stage passes current registered execution and all applicable frozen manual semantic requirements. Controlled-cut source is unfinished and ungraded; its receiver must independently complete. UNKNOWN, missing evidence, ordinary FAIL and VETO are never PASS.
